# Speaking Latino

> > Speaking Latino provides comprehensive guides and resources for mastering Spanish slang and Latin American Spanish, created by language experts Jared and Diana.

This site specializes in teaching authentic Spanish slang and colloquialisms used across Latin America, offering practice tests, lesson plans, and teacher resources for learners at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Spanish slang
- Latin American Spanish
- Language learning
- Teacher resources
- Lesson plans
- Speaking Latino
- Jared and Diana
- Spanish practice tests
- Colloquial Spanish
- Spanish dialects

## Learning Resources & Practice

- [Master Spanish Slang: Guides & Resources from Experts](https://www.speakinglatino.com/spanish-language-practice-tests): Spanish slang practice tests and learning resources by Jared & Diana
